name: Business Messaging for WbizTool
author: Anurag Meena

sections.description:
Transform your WordPress site into a powerful business communication hub!

Business Messaging for WbizTool seamlessly connects your WordPress website with instant messaging, enabling automatic notifications for WooCommerce orders, WP Amelia bookings, and other events.

🚀 Key Features

WooCommerce Integration:
* Order creation notifications
* Order status updates (processing, completed, shipped)
* Payment confirmations and failures
* Cancellation and refund notifications
* 50+ dynamic variables for personalization

Contact Form 7 Integration:
* Instant admin notifications for new submissions
* Automatic customer thank you messages
* Support for all form field types
* Smart phone number detection
* Admin and customer message templates

WP Amelia Integration:
* Booking confirmations and updates
* Appointment reminders
* Payment notifications
* Rescheduling alerts
* Service and provider information

Professional Templates:
* Pre-built message templates for all scenarios
* Customizable with 50+ dynamic variables
* Support for customer details, order info, booking data
* Easy template editor with variable insertion

Advanced Features:
* Test mode for safe development
* Message logging and analytics
* Phone number validation
* International country code support
* CSV export of message logs
* Connection testing tools

💼 Perfect For

  • Any WordPress site – Get instant notifications for contact form submissions
  • E-commerce stores – Keep customers informed about their orders
  • Service businesses – Send booking confirmations and reminders
  • Agencies – Provide professional communication for clients
  • Freelancers – Never miss a potential client inquiry

🔧 Easy Setup

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Get your API credentials from WbizTool.com
  3. Configure the plugin settings
  4. Customize message templates
  5. Start sending automated business messages!

📱 Why Business Messaging?

  • 2+ billion users worldwide – Reach customers where they are
  • 98% open rate – Much higher than email
  • Instant delivery – Real-time notifications
  • Personal touch – Direct communication channel

🎯 Use Cases

For Contact Form 7:
* “🔔 New contact from John Smith: ‘Interested in your web design services. Please call me!'”
* “Thank you for contacting us! We’ve received your inquiry and will respond within 24 hours.”
* “New quote request from ABC Company for mobile app development.”

For WooCommerce:
* “Hi John, your order #1234 has been confirmed and will be processed shortly!”
* “Great news! Your order has shipped and will arrive by Friday.”
* “Your payment of $99.99 has been received. Thank you for your purchase!”

For WP Amelia:
* “Hi Sarah, your appointment for Hair Styling on Dec 15 at 2:00 PM is confirmed!”
* “Reminder: Your appointment with Dr. Smith is tomorrow at 10:00 AM.”
* “Your booking has been rescheduled to Dec 20 at 3:00 PM.”

🛡️ Security & Privacy

  • All data is securely transmitted via HTTPS
  • No sensitive information is stored unnecessarily
  • Full compliance with WordPress security standards
  • Phone numbers are validated and formatted properly

🌍 International Support

  • Supports all international phone number formats
  • Automatic country code detection
  • Multi-language ready (translation files included)
  • Works with any currency and date format

Third Party Services

This plugin connects to WbizTool’s external service to send business messages:

Service: WbizTool API
URL: https://wbiztool.com
Purpose: Send business messages via their API
Terms of Service: https://wbiztool.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://wbiztool.com/privacy/

When you use this plugin, certain data (phone numbers, message content) is transmitted to WbizTool’s servers to deliver business messages. No sensitive data is stored permanently.

Support

Need help? We’re here for you!

  • Documentation: WbizTool WordPress Integration Guide
  • Video Tutorials: Setup and Configuration Videos
  • Email Support: support@wbiztool.com
  • Live Chat: Available on WbizTool.com

For feature requests and bug reports, please contact our support team or visit our website.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “WbizTool Business Messaging”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the zip file and click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin

Configuration

  1. Go to WbizTool in your WordPress admin menu
  2. Enter your API credentials from WbizTool.com
  3. Test your connection
  4. Enable desired integrations (WooCommerce, WP Amelia)
  5. Customize message templates
  6. Send a test message to verify everything works
sections.faq:
Do I need a WbizTool account?

Yes, you need a WbizTool account to use this plugin. You can sign up for free at WbizTool.com.

Which plugins are supported?

Currently supported:
* Contact Form 7 – For contact form submissions and inquiries
* WooCommerce – For e-commerce order notifications
* WP Amelia – For booking and appointment management

Can I customize the messages?

Absolutely! The plugin includes a powerful template editor where you can:
* Use 50+ dynamic variables
* Create custom messages for each event
* Preview messages with sample data
* Save and organize multiple templates

Is there a limit on messages?

Message limits depend on your WbizTool plan:
* Free Plan: 10 messages per minute
* Paid Plans: 100+ messages per minute
* Enterprise: Custom limits available

Does it work internationally?

Yes! The plugin supports:
* All international phone number formats
* Automatic country code detection
* Multiple languages and currencies
* Global message delivery

Can I test before going live?

Yes, the plugin includes a comprehensive test mode:
* Test API connections
* Send test messages
* Preview templates with sample data
* View detailed logs and analytics

What if I need help?

We provide multiple support channels:
* Plugin documentation
* Video tutorials
* Email support at support@wbiztool.com
* Live chat on our website
